name: shape-membrane
title: Elastic Membrane Press
description: Một màng căng giữa hai chốt bị ngón tay ấn lõm xuống 36 px ở giữa, thả ra thì màng bật lên rung mạnh nhiều nhịp rồi phẳng lại.

moworks.author: moworks

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: A 208 px line pinned at both ends (small posts). A finger (r11) comes down 0.15-0.5 s and presses the centre: dip 0 → 36 px over 0.5-1.0 s power2.inOut, profile depth × (1 − u²)(1 − 0.25 u²) (u = −1 to 1). Release at 1.4 s: depth returns on a spring k180 d5 (strong wobble); the finger lifts 1.4-1.75 s and fades. 14 % accent fill under the curve, 4 px round-cap stroke. Params: dip (36 px, 0.5 s, power2.inOut) · release (1.4 s) · spring (k180 c5) · span (208 px). Profile depth × (1 − u²)(1 − 0.25 u²) across the span.
